source.privacy_manifest_na_reason: App target contains no first-party native code accessing required-reason APIs. All native code ships in Capacitor frameworks, which bundle their own PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy manifests with empty accessed-API/data/tracking declarations.

unchecked_entitlements.beta-reports-active: Xcode adds this for App Store/TestFlight distribution.

unchecked_info_keys.BuildMachineOSBuild: Xcode-recorded build host OS version; toolchain-generated, varies by builder.
unchecked_info_keys.CFBundleDevelopmentRegion: ja; primary development region matching the app primary language.
unchecked_info_keys.CFBundleDisplayName: Relay; user-visible name under the home-screen icon.
unchecked_info_keys.CFBundleIcons: Xcode-generated iPhone icon table from the AppIcon asset catalog.
unchecked_info_keys.CFBundleIcons~ipad: Xcode-generated iPad icon table from the AppIcon asset catalog.
unchecked_info_keys.CFBundleLocalizations: ja and en; declared localizations matching release metadata.
unchecked_info_keys.CFBundleName: App; Xcode product name (user-visible name comes from CFBundleDisplayName).
unchecked_info_keys.LSRequiresIPhoneOS: true; iOS-only app, cannot run on other platforms.
unchecked_info_keys.NSAppTransportSecurity: NSAllowsLocalNetworking only, for cleartext HTTP to the paired Mac/PC relay server on LAN; no arbitrary loads.
unchecked_info_keys.UIDeviceFamily: 1 and 2; universal iPhone plus iPad build from the Capacitor template.
unchecked_info_keys.UILaunchStoryboardName: LaunchScreen storyboard from the Capacitor Xcode template.
unchecked_info_keys.UIMainStoryboardFile: Main storyboard from the Capacitor Xcode template.
unchecked_info_keys.UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities: arm64 only; matches the single shipped architecture.
unchecked_info_keys.UISupportedInterfaceOrientations: portrait plus both landscapes on iPhone.

bundles.policy_reason: Relay 1.0.0 has no extensions, no background modes, no usage descriptions, and no custom entitlements. Closed-world Info/entitlement values are cross-checked against the signed IPA at binary stage.
